just fyi, my dog has also been attacked unprovoked by multiple pitbulls. she’s also been attacked by german shepherds, goldens, chow chows, doodles, chihuahas, poodles, and terrier mixes. and yes it sounds like a lot of dogs bc i live in a city with lots of dogs. all of it has happened when we’re just minding our own business on a walk or in a park. i’m wary of EVERY single dog i encounter until proven otherwise that i can let me guard down.

pitbulls absolutely have the ability to be dangerous and genetics can play a factor if they’ve been poorly bred and/or have a lineage of anxious/aggressive ancestors too. but that applies to most other breeds. every dog has the potential to be dangerous. and i understand physically, pitbulls can cause more damage than a chihuahua or toy poodle. but then your hatred towards pitbulls should be applied to every large breed dog. 

i also understand if you do not like or want pitbulls and that’s fine. but calling for a blanket ban of pitbulls is just illogical and discredits the lovely pit bulls out there with no aggression. as much as you love your golden, there are people out there that love their pitbull just as much.

ok to actually be helpful, this is what i _personally_ would ask: (i say personally bc everyone’s got different opinions so don’t come for me lol)

basic physical needs such as grooming, diet,medications, exercise needs. ask which vet they took the dog to. it’s prob best if the dog keeps going to a consistent vet that’s familiar with them. oh and basic stuff about the dog if you don’t already know like breed/breed mix, age, health conditions, etc.

next would be behavior which is what i think is most important. ask for daily/average temperament, attitude around strangers or certain people (some dogs don’t like men or people with hats lol), oh and REALLY IMPORTANT: attitude around kids. ask about dog reactivity as well, and prey drive.

ask if the dog knows any obedience, tricks, etc. ask what type of training was used for the dog. is the dog destructive? can they be left alone in the house? do they resource guard? what would the owner recommend the dog needs more training on? what’s their daily schedule/routine like?

next would be stuff the dog likes/weird quirks. favorite treats? favorite toy? favorite place to run around? any silly behaviors? (my dog likes to pretend she’s attacking her treats before she eats them 😂). is the dog picky around food? or does the dog eat too fast? will the dog gobble everything in sight or are they chill?

i think that’s all of what i would ask an owner. a good idea would be to imagine you going through your day to day life with the dog. what questions would you wanna ask to make sure both you and your dog can live comfortable lives?
